title: Law to create resources and rights for doulas
summary: This bill would require the city's health department to publish a "Doula Bill of Rights" explaining laws affecting doulas within 6 months, and to create a feedback form for doulas working in city hospitals, reporting a summary annually. It would also establish a Doula Advisory Council of doulas, recent parents, the health commissioner and a Health + Hospitals representative to study doula services and advise the Citywide Doula Program, meeting at least quarterly.
